title: Molly and the Wet Corner
synopsis: Molly notices an unexpected drip beside the red barn wagon door. Farmer Ruth and Mr. Lee inspect the little side shelter; the main barn and its stored hay remain dry, and the adults plan a focused repair.
continuity_state: Before: Season Nine ended in early spring with the worn strip beside Pine Park gate repaired; all earlier farm buildings and stored hay remain intact. Several weeks have passed; Molly still lives at Green Gate Farm. After: A passing spring shower has exposed a leak at the junction of the red barn wall and its small exterior wagon-door shelter roof. A weathered edge board is also soft. Farmer Ruth and Mr. Lee close off only the side shelter area and plan to rebuild that shelter in the same place. Main barn, red tractor, dry hay and animals are unaffected; no repair materials have arrived.
